repository.note: The exact pinned 334-entry tree contains no LICENSE/COPYING file and the reviewed GitHub metadata has no detected licence. No separate compiled-menu redistribution grant was established.

scope.comparisonBasis: Each staged original was rehashed as bytes and verified against its pinned Git tree blob. Current action manifests, generated catalogue and download audit were read again; filenames alone did not determine duplication.

summary.note: The reviewed 5.05/6.72 menu set is fully enumerated but not exhausted as downloadable historical variants. After the four selected Oysters BINs, six distinct native files remain. No remaining file gained a verified generic sender ABI.

sourceDispatch.firmwareLabel: PS4 5.05 FW Host v2.5 by GamerHack
sourceDispatch.nativeContract: load_payload GETs PLfile as ArrayBuffer, writes native words at code_addr1 + 0x100000 and calls p.fcall(code_addr1). exploit.js separately establishes native loader memory. This host-specific execution path does not establish raw BIN compatibility with GoldHEN HTTP 9090, TCP 9020 or ELF-loader protocols.

sourceDispatch.finding: Menu functions assign the exact BIN name then call loadScript1. The pinned loadScript1 routes through getScript, which creates a script element, despite the reviewed menu files beginning with native bytes. A separate native loader is embedded earlier in the same page. Static source therefore records mixed loader paths and does not prove successful execution of these menu branches.

explicitExclusions.reason: The .bin object is UTF-8 JavaScript beginning var payload = [. The pinned 5.05 dispatch nevertheless fetches it as ArrayBuffer and copies the text bytes as native words. It is not a ready raw BIN; no conversion, execution, ready-asset record, public action, inventory addition or generic BIN Load was created.
